articles.title: GE Vernova Wins Contract to Upgrade Power Plants in Egypt
articles.mainIdea: GE Vernova Wins Contract to Upgrade Power Plants in Egypt
articles.summary: InvestorsHub: GE Vernova Wins Contract to Upgrade Power Plants in Egypt. GE Vernova Inc. (NYSE:GEV) has secured a contract from the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company, part of the Egyptian Electricity Holding Company, to modernize generation assets at the Bahna and Nubaria power plants in Egypt.
